# Mistral Vibe headless 2.24.2 identity corpus

Secret-free source identity for `mistral-vibe.headless` before any
Swallowtail package or claim exists.

Official GitHub `v2.24.2` / PyPI `mistral-vibe==2.24.2` freeze the
selected print wire: `vibe --prompt … --output streaming --max-turns N
--trust --agent plan --workdir DIR`. Stdout is completed public-history
NDJSON. `vibe-acp`, TUI, `--continue`/`--resume`, teleport, and
`--auto-approve`/`--yolo` are not this corpus.

No live `--prompt`. No provider prompt. No install. No host `vibe`.

No fixture contains a credential, host path, account identity, provider
payload, or real session id.
